exposure: Myasthenia gravis severity (Category A: systemic muscle weakness or worsening symptoms; Category B: no symptoms)
cohort: Six pregnant women with myasthenia gravis.
finding: This case series suggests that women with myasthenia gravis can safely undergo spontaneous or operative vaginal delivery with a protocol utilizing epidural labor analgesia based on disease severity.
